semantic_evidence.original_quote: List the agreements at meeting RAN1#115 that approved a CR (tracing spec-change decisions).
query_clauses:
MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN1#115'})
WHERE (a.content CONTAINS 'CR' AND (a.content CONTAINS 'agreed' OR a.content CONTAINS 'approved'))
   OR (a.content =~ '(?is).*\\b(?:agree(?:d)?|approv(?:ed|e)|endors(?:ed|e)|adopt(?:ed)?|adapt(?:ed)?)\\b.*'
       AND a.content =~ '(?is).*\\b(?:TPs?|text\\s+proposals?)\\b.*'
       AND (a.content =~ '(?is).*\\bTS\\s*\\d{2}\\.\\d{3}\\b.*'
            OR a.content =~ '(?is).*\\b(?:TPs?|text\\s+proposals?)\\s+\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)*(?:-\\d+)?(?:\\s*\\([^)]*\\))?.*\\bsection\\s+\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)+.*\\bR1-\\d{7}\\b.*'))
semantic_evidence.finding: Original affirmative class authority includes CR/draftCR/pCR, including unnumbered proposals. Approval of an inline/named CR-form proposal or an explicit current amendment qualifies without final/numbered/plenary approval requirements. Bare TP later captured by a CR does not establish approval of the CR proposal object: raw16TP1 is excluded while preserving its exact normative adoption/CR2777 lineage. Named TP2.4-1 at raw44 is included because its actual source contains the Reason/Summary/Consequences CR-form payload. The generic retained-text query preserves the literal original branch and adds approval+TP+(TS or named TP/section/Tdoc) grammar without ID, source-gold, or parameter literals.
